external_prerequisites.PEER-CORE: BE-002 / G1 must provide reviewed canonical operation schemas, semantic and negative vectors, C#/TS field mappings, versions, digests and fingerprint algorithm. Runtime codec implementation and bidirectional binary exchange are separate G2 gates; see COORDINATION.md.
external_prerequisites.PEER-VALUE: Backend owner must freeze catalog/app-binding, wallet, inventory, entitlement and reward-receipt schemas, atomic-group projections and business-source uniqueness.
external_prerequisites.PEER-OBJECTIVES: Backend owner must freeze objective kinds/versions, occurrence keys, definition migration and claim/finalization schemas with duplicate-source fixtures.
external_prerequisites.PEER-COMMERCE: Backend owner must freeze offer/price/eligibility/purchase/verification state and provider receipt handling, without trusting local purchase UI.
external_prerequisites.PEER-SOCIAL: Backend owner must freeze team membership/contribution and leaderboard query/score/season/snapshot schemas and authorization.
external_prerequisites.PEER-CONFIG-INBOX: Backend owner must freeze assignment/visibility-scoped config and inbox read/claim commands with attachment receipt semantics.
external_prerequisites.PEER-LIVE-SLICE: Real nonproduction auth+PostgreSQL service, explicit seed command/app registration, test result validation and one reward plan, real receipts/feed/snapshot implementation; exact compatible backend commit and endpoint supplied through secure environment configuration.
external_prerequisites.PEER-FEATURE-APIS: Real nonproduction APIs and seeded fixtures for each of sixteen modules; record host-specific results, not fictitious portability.
external_prerequisites.ENV-UNITY-ANDROID: Licensed Unity 6000.5.3f1 with Android SDK/NDK/OpenJDK and IL2CPP. No runner/license availability assumed.
external_prerequisites.ENV-ANDROID-DEVICE: Authorized ARM64 Android test device with ADB, known test app data and safe kill/restart/network fault controls. Never clear production data.
external_prerequisites.ENV-IAP-SANDBOX: Explicitly authorized store sandbox/test product setup and backend verification credentials. No real purchases/spend.
external_prerequisites.DEC-LEGACY-TRUST: Owner decision: recommend preserve legacy progress locally as unverified import, not trusted reward entitlement. Bind import once to an explicitly selected provisioned account; no automatic merging or replay grants.
external_prerequisites.DEC-CONTENT-VALIDATION: Backend/game owner must agree a versioned test-content validation policy for real offline outcomes. Client signatures are evidence inputs, not server-trusted proof; no generic backend import of puzzle assemblies.
